primary_sources.title: Richard Fitzpatrick, WKB Approximation, University of Texas at Austin
primary_sources.support: Constant-mass smooth-potential forbidden-region decay exponent and applicability limits.
primary_sources.does_not_support: Abrupt heterostructure interface matching or material-specific barrier/mass values.

selected_model.segment_energy: U in joules, before incident-energy subtraction
selected_model.incident_energy: one global E in joules at the same reference as all U endpoints
selected_model.mass: constant positive m*/m0 within each segment
selected_model.interface: independent one-sided endpoints, no finite interpolation across a discontinuity
selected_model.approximation: sum positive forbidden-region segment actions only; no coherent matching
selected_model.electrostatic_sign: electron energy contribution is -q*potential; no automatic potential conversion
selected_model.reversal: same landscape and same E, segment order and endpoint order reversed; not reverse-bias recomputation
selected_model.underflow: zero transmission, retain finite exponent and log transmission

numerical_acceptance.scope: Predeclared S2/S3 acceptance targets, not measured accuracy; positive homogeneous mass controls, analytic rectangle/linear/turning-point limits and independent refined quadrature required before acceptance.
numerical_acceptance.outside_scope: Representable adversarial inputs outside controlled ranges need explicit failure/unavailable diagnostics, not an extrapolated accuracy guarantee.

implementation_boundary: S1 stores/validates declarations only; S2 evaluator and S4 attachment are absent.
